tools.name: list_screens
tools.description: List the connected team's screens: online status and what each screen and sub-screen shows right now (its normal content, pushed content, a scene or screen mirroring), with the end time if there is one. Also returns the account's time zone and current local time. Filter with query (part of a screen

tools.name: search_content
tools.description: Search the team's content that can be shown on a screen: files, designs, apps, split screens and playlists. Newest first. Returns the id, name and type of each item.

tools.name: push_content
tools.description: Show content on one screen, or on one sub-screen of a split screen, in place of what it shows now, until a time or until it is put back to normal. A split screen needs a subscreen_id. Returns what the screen shows afterwards. Content only appears once the screen is online and has a player paired; th

tools.name: release_screen
tools.description: End pushed content or a scene on one screen or sub-screen; it goes back to its own content.

tools.name: list_scenes
tools.description: List the team's scenes in their order, with their state (live, partly live, changed since it went live, off) and which screens and sub-screens each scene sets (at most 20 targets per scene; targets_total is the real number). Results come in pages: pass next_cursor as cursor for the next page.

tools.name: activate_scene
tools.description: Put a scene live: every screen and sub-screen in the scene switches at once, in place of what it shows. Running it again puts changes to the scene live. A screen only shows the scene once it is online and has a player paired; each result includes online and paired when the connection may read screen

tools.name: release_scene
tools.description: End one scene: its screens go back to their own content.

tools.name: release_all
tools.description: End all scenes and all pushed content on the team's screens. Screen mirroring keeps running.

tools.name: create_design
tools.description: Create a design (a full-screen slide for a screen, such as a menu, an announcement or an event poster) from a description. tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Search the Screenbird help center (how features work, setup, troubleshooting). Returns up to 3 articles with title, summary and link; set full to true for the complete text of each article.

tools.name: get_install_steps
tools.description: Steps to install the Screenbird player on a device type, ending with the pairing code that the user enters in the dashboard.

tools.name: check_device
tools.description: Check whether a device (as the user names it, for example "Samsung TV", "Chromecast", "iPad") works with Screenbird. Returns works, coming_soon, does_not_work, works_in_browser or unknown, with an explanation.
